# Master Emergency Hardening & Patch Runbook: JetBrains TeamCity On-Premises (CVE-2026-63077)

**Document Target:** 48-Hour Emergency CI/CD Hardening Sprint  
**Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-63077 (CVSS 9.8 — Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Agent Polling Protocol)  
**Date:** July 30, 2026  
**Status:** COMPLETE & READY FOR CLIENT DEPLOYMENT  

---

## Executive Summary & Situation Report

On July 27, 2026, JetBrains disclosed **CVE-2026-63077**, a critical CVSS 9.8 flaw impacting all versions of TeamCity On-Premises. The vulnerability resides in the agent polling protocol (`/app/agents/protocols` and legacy XML-RPC endpoints), allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary operating system commands on exposed TeamCity servers.

Given the 72-hour weaponization window observed for critical CI/CD exploits, any unpatched TeamCity server exposed to external networks or unsegmented internal subnets must be treated as **potentially compromised**.

This master runbook and associated deliverable package provide an end-to-end, production-grade 48-hour emergency response protocol.

---
